definitions.explanation: To seize someone and struggle with them body to body, as in a fight or a wrestling bout.

definitions.gloss: to tackle; to get to grips with
definitions.explanation: To set about a difficult task or problem in earnest; a more colloquial, vigorous-sounding equivalent of the standard word for tackling a task.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{取|と}っ{組|く}んだ。
examples.english: The brothers grappled with each other.
The two wrestled on the floor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{怒|おこ}った→怒る：00876_okoru⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{取|と}っ{組|く}んで、⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: An angry customer grappled with a clerk, and the police were called.

examples.japanese: ⟦{難問|なんもん}→難問：18031_nanmon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}っ{組|く}む。
⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{取|と}っ{組|く}んで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I spent the weekend wrestling with my homework.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{本気|ほんき}→本気：03153_honki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{取|と}っ{組|く}んでみたら、⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}かった→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
examples.english: When I really got to grips with the new job, it turned out to be surprisingly interesting.

notes:
Most often met today in the noun ⟦{取|と}っ{組|く}み{合|あ}い→取っ組み合い：17722_tokkumiai⟧ (a scuffle) and in the phrase ⟦{取|と}っ{組|く}み{合|あ}い→取っ組み合い：17722_tokkumiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧ (a fistfight).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{取|と}っ{組|く}む: to grapple with someone
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}っ{組|く}む: to tackle a task
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}っ{組|く}む: to get to grips with a problem

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: the ordinary word for tackling a task; {取|と}っ{組|く}む sounds more physical and colloquial, and is the usual choice for a scuffle (⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧ in that sense is mostly a sumo term).
